title: PLUTUS GUI Trade Markers Overlay (read-only)
established_by: R2D2 (post-handover authority) per Matt's stated visualisation need + architect drift_protection rule (new scope = new WO, never silent creep)
rationale: Matt's killer use case ('replay 28/3/26 and find out why we missed that setup') requires seeing WHERE trades happened on the chart to diagnose. Trade markers are load-bearing for post-mortem use. WO-1B shipped without them; this WO adds them as a proper scope-locked patch rather than silent v1B re-open.
scope_in: Render trade markers on the breathing chart (entries as triangles or dots, exits as squares — Rogue's call on visual style)
Marker source: SELECT from existing tables only — sessions, orders, ticks (no new schema)
Marker fields visible on hover: order_id, side (BUY/SELL), price, sim_ts, fill status, pnl if closed
Markers anchor to sim_ts on the existing breathing chart x-axis
Markers respect the existing window selector (1m/5m/15m/1h)
Add /api/trade_markers endpoint (read-only, plutus_ro user) returning markers in current window
scope_out_HARD_LIMIT: NO @app.post/put/delete/patch routes added (Control #2 architect-locked — stays at zero)
NO new DB schema (sessions/orders are existing v0.5 tables)
NO writes to plutus DB from GUI (plutus_ro user only — verified via INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE permission denial test)
NO scope into PLUTUS engine — render-only on existing data

config_db_impact.db_migrations: NONE — markers source from existing sessions/orders tables
config_db_impact.db_user_impact: Continues to use plutus_ro only (no new permissions)

tests_canaries: All WO-1B smoke battery tests still PASS (regression)
grep verification: zero @app.post/@app.put/@app.delete/@app.patch in main.py (Control #2 invariant)
plutus_ro INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE permission-denied test still passes (MariaDB 1142 errors verified)
/api/trade_markers returns 200 with marker JSON when authenticated; returns 401 when unauthenticated
Marker render verified visually in dashboard — hover-tooltip shows order_id + side + price + sim_ts
Empty-orders edge case: chart renders normally with no markers (no JS errors, no broken layout)
rollback_note: Disable via docker-compose image rollback to mt5-plutus-web:1.0. Markers are additive overlay; removing the /api/trade_markers endpoint + frontend marker layer reverts cleanly.
closed_green_criteria: All scope_in items delivered + visually verified in dashboard at http://192.168.11.10:3013/
Container mt5-plutus-web:1.1 labelled with vcs-ref matching merge SHA
Tag v1.1-gui pushed on mt5_plutus repo
R2D2 acceptance review: walk through dashboard, verify markers render correctly on a known scenario with completed trades, sign off in sim_broker:reports:WO-PLUTUS-V1-1B-PATCH:v1

checklist.config_db_impact: filled per WO body — minimal (version bumps only)
checklist.tests_canaries: filled per WO body — heavy emphasis on Control #2 regression
checklist.rollback_note: filled per WO body — clean image rollback

parallel_with: May run in parallel with WO-PLUTUS-V1-1A (Safety Canary) — separate worktrees, separate scope, no shared mutable surface (per architect Control #1)
drift_protection_compliance: This WO honours the architect drift_protection rule by being a properly-scoped lightweight WO with bounded scope_in + hard scope_out, not silent re-opening of WO-1B. R2D2 (post-handover authority) called this scope add per Matt's stated need + Solo's deferral to R2D2 call. Architect notified via fabric record.
non_goals: Mobile-optimized layout (deferred to v0.6 with WO-1B's deferred mobile scope)
Advanced filtering of markers (filter by side, date range, etc. — scope creep, deferred)
Trade marker editing or annotation (NEVER — Control #2 absolute)
